researchCase.why: Buffalo is a home favorite at -3.5; +6.5 buys ten points of cushion and covers a six-point loss. Ed Oliver is expected back with no injury designation.
researchCase.risk: Lamar Jackson is expected to return from his ankle injury. Buffalo has multiple questionable starters, including Spencer Brown, DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid. Baltimore can win this outright.
researchCase.availability: Official Friday report checked today: Oliver has no designation; Moore, Kincaid, Brown, Alford, Gaines and Parker are questionable. Final inactives are not yet available.

sources.fact: Bills expect Ed Oliver back without a game designation; six players remain questionable after the Parker update. Baltimore expects Lamar Jackson to return.

researchCase.why: Pittsburgh is favored by 3.5 at home; taking +4.5 adds eight points and covers a field-goal loss in a game priced at 39.5 total. I prefer that cushion to asking Pittsburgh to cover.
researchCase.risk: A divisional matchup can stay tight or swing on turnovers. Pittsburgh has defensive-line players on injured reserve and two defensive backs ruled out; the cushion is not protection against a poor defensive game.
researchCase.availability: Official Steelers Friday report checked today: Echols and Slaughter out, Skowronek questionable; Joseph-Day and Harmon on IR. Elliott returned last week but a full workload is not assumed. Final inactives pending.

sources.fact: Echols and Slaughter ruled out; Skowronek questionable. Joseph-Day and Harmon are on injured reserve; Elliott returned for 19 defensive snaps last week.
